queries.sql: select * from "semester" where "sekolah_id" = ? and "semester"."sekolah_id" = ? order by "tanggal_mulai" desc

select "roles".*, "model_has_roles"."model_id" as "pivot_model_id", "model_has_roles"."role_id" as "pivot_role_id", "model_has_roles"."model_type" as "pivot_model_type", "model_has_roles"."sekolah_id" as "pivot_sekolah_id" from "roles" inner join "model_has_roles" on "roles"."id" = "model_has_roles"."role_id" where "model_has_roles"."sekolah_id" = ? and ("roles"."sekolah_id" is null or "roles"."sekolah_id" = ?) and "model_has_roles"."model_id" in (118) and "model_has_roles"."model_type" = ?

select "permissions".*, "model_has_permissions"."model_id" as "pivot_model_id", "model_has_permissions"."permission_id" as "pivot_permission_id", "model_has_permissions"."model_type" as "pivot_model_type", "model_has_permissions"."sekolah_id" as "pivot_sekolah_id" from "permissions" inner join "model_has_permissions" on "permissions"."id" = "model_has_permissions"."permission_id" where "model_has_permissions"."model_id" = ? and "model_has_permissions"."model_type" = ? and "model_has_permissions"."sekolah_id" = ?

select "permissions".*, "role_has_permissions"."role_id" as "pivot_role_id", "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" as "pivot_permission_id" from "permissions" inner join "role_has_permissions" on "permissions"."id" = "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" where "role_has_permissions"."role_id" in (562)

select "roles".*, "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" as "pivot_permission_id", "role_has_permissions"."role_id" as "pivot_role_id" from "roles" inner join "role_has_permissions" on "roles"."id" = "role_has_permissions"."role_id" where "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" in (1681, 1682, 1683, 1684, 1685, 1686, 1687, 1688, 1689, 1690, 1691, 1692, 1693, 1694, 1695, 1696, 1697, 1698, 1699, 1700, 1701)
select count(*) as "aggregate" from "siswa" where "siswa"."sekolah_id" = ? and "siswa"."deleted_at" is null
select * from "siswa" where "siswa"."sekolah_id" = ? and "siswa"."deleted_at" is null order by "nama" asc limit 25 offset 0

select * from "anggota_rombel" where exists (select * from "semester" where "anggota_rombel"."semester_id" = "semester"."id" and "is_aktif" = ? and "semester"."sekolah_id" = ?) and "anggota_rombel"."siswa_id" in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) and "anggota_rombel"."sekolah_id" = ?
select "id", "nama", "tingkat" from "rombel" where "semester_id" = ? and "rombel"."sekolah_id" = ? order by "tingkat" asc, "nama" asc
